description: “As a proud member of Local 34 at Yale University, standing up for hardworking people has always been one of my top priorities,” said Karen Martin. “I am grateful for the Connecticut AFL-CIO’s trust and support, and I am ready to put their mission into action for working East Haven families.”
paid_for_by: Paid for by the committee to elect Karen Martin for State Representative Treasurer Rich Esposito, Approved by Karen Martin bottom of page
title: Karen Proudly Receives Connecticut AFL-CIO Endorsement
